method: Compared 114 initial and 116 final open AI Mode tabs and 10 recent history entries through the previous archive boundary. Added three conversations (1100-1102), with 21 prompts and 21 response blocks. Reopened two saved conversation pages to recover an empty image response and a missing first prompt. All three transcripts were read back; conversation 1099 remains unchanged. Two generated doodles and two graphs, plus available reference thumbnails, are embedded. One original Google error response is preserved. No new uploaded attachments or embedded widgets were present. Earlier titles, original attachments and source-access gaps remain preserved. Unsent drafts are excluded.
